name: Ezekiel
overview: Ezekiel's Defence level of 130 can be reduced to a minimum of 78 (130 \times 0.6 = 78).

During Enrage phase, Ezekiel brings all players into a 3x3 arena and begins shooting volleys of 3 lightning attacks. The volley of attacks are indicated by which swords are struck with lightning. These attacks can be dodged by running to the tile corresponding to the sword that was not struck by lightning.
